summary: Synthetic sample data shows acquisition costs increasing and campaign email click rate declining. This is a proposed review, with distinct attribution and no vendor API operations.

experiments.title: Test a product-specific Search message
experiments.hypothesis: A product-specific message may qualify dinnerware intent more effectively than generic category copy and reduce purchase-credit CPA.
experiments.change: Compare a broad collection-message draft with a product-specific headline/description bundle. The real control copy has not been supplied. Keep keywords, bid strategy, landing page, geography and total approved budget unchanged.
experiments.design: Proposed randomized campaign experiment, with allocation and platform eligibility confirmed by the account owner. This is a creative-message bundle test; it cannot isolate an individual headline.
experiments.primary: Google Ads Purchase-credit CPA under the existing 30-day click / data-driven definition.
experiments.guardrails: Monitor CPC, purchase-credit volume, search-term relevance and product availability; no budget increase or automatic rollout.
experiments.decision: Pre-register the sample size and uncertainty interval needed to evaluate a 20% CPA improvement. Run for at least two full weeks and allow the attribution window to mature; neither duration alone nor a raw point estimate establishes a winner.
experiments.feasibility: Only 48 current-week non-brand purchase credits. Power, duration and conversion lag require analyst review; the available aggregate export cannot establish a statistically powered CPA test.
experiments.effort: 3–5 setup/QA hours after evidence and approval; no setup executed

experiments.title: Test a fresh video-opening concept
experiments.hypothesis: A fresh opening concept may restore attention and acquisition efficiency in the existing prospecting audience.
experiments.change: Test a product-close-up opening against a table-setting opening as two draft creative concepts. Keep audience, placements, optimization event, landing URL and total approved budget fixed.
experiments.design: Proposed Meta A/B experiment with non-overlapping randomized audiences. Creative concepts include their opening message and visual treatment; results would apply to the bundle.
experiments.primary: Meta-attributed purchase CPA under the existing 7-day click + 1-day view definition. Link CTR is a diagnostic metric.
experiments.guardrails: Check attribution settings, frequency, unique reach, purchase volume and brand/product claims. No automatic budget shift or winner promotion.
experiments.decision: Agree a power/sample plan using randomized users and purchase outcomes before activation. Review at least two full weeks, then allow conversions to mature. Repeated impressions are not independent users.
experiments.feasibility: 15 current-week video-attributed purchases is a small base. Frequency is 4.00; fatigue is a hypothesis, not a proven cause. Creative assets and a power review are still needed.
experiments.effort: 4–6 concept/QA hours; final video assets not produced

experiments.title: Test subject-line relevance within one segment
experiments.hypothesis: A concrete table-setting subject line may improve clicks within the same engaged audience without relying on open-rate changes.
experiments.change: Randomize two subject lines within the Engaged 30d email segment. Keep the sender, preheader, body, CTA, delivery time and eligibility/suppression rules identical.
experiments.design: Proposed recipient-level A/B test. Analyse per-message unique click rate within the selected segment; do not compare differently sized or differently engaged segments as experimental arms.
experiments.primary: Per-message unique clickers / delivered messages, using the same bot filtering in each arm.
experiments.guardrails: Unsubscribe and spam complaint rates, consent, suppression, deliverability and placed-order attribution. No SMS, audience expansion or message send.
experiments.decision: Set the minimum sample and detectable lift before sending. A single split of the current 5,000-profile engaged segment may be underpowered for a modest lift; do not declare a winner from opens or an early point estimate.
experiments.feasibility: The campaign audience mix changed between weeks. Current engaged clicks are 120/5,000 (2.4%), versus 150/5,000 (3.0%). The planned test isolates subject line only; sample-size feasibility remains an expert check.
experiments.effort: 2–3 copy/segment QA hours after approval; no draft created in Klaviyo

backlog.title: Confirm the real client, brief and reporting setup
backlog.fix: Confirm agency/client relationship, platform scope, goals, approved exports, brand claims, timezone, currency and the selected Client Hub setup.
backlog.reasoning: All current client details and metrics are scenario assumptions. Real review depends on approved inputs.
backlog.acceptance: A named owner confirms the scope, brief, accounts and reporting destination; no external write is authorized by this demo.

backlog.title: Reconcile measurement definitions and conversion maturity
backlog.fix: Verify conversion actions, attribution windows, event vs interaction vs message-send date, MPP/bot settings and purchase-value/refund treatment. Schedule a separate approved re-extract after appropriate windows mature.
backlog.reasoning: Aligned calendar periods do not make differently attributed revenue additive or final.
backlog.acceptance: Metric dictionary and cutoff are approved; platform revenue remains separate; remaining lag and deduplication gaps are explicit.

backlog.title: Approve sample sizes and experiment eligibility
backlog.fix: Define randomization, primary metrics, detectable effects, sample requirements and guardrails. Check actual platform support, traffic volume and unique-profile counts.
backlog.reasoning: Weekly observations and small purchase bases cannot establish causality or a statistically significant winner.
backlog.acceptance: A pre-registered decision rule and feasible sample/duration are accepted for each of E1–E3, or the test is deferred.

backlog.title: Prepare Search experiment E1 for review
backlog.fix: Review search-term intent and draft message bundles. Confirm existing landing page, product facts and unchanged budget before any separate activation decision.
backlog.reasoning: Non-brand CPA doubled and generic-query spend share increased; the message test is a hypothesis to evaluate.
backlog.acceptance: E1 design, copy and evidence reviewed. No campaign launched, keyword changed or budget modified.

backlog.title: Prepare Meta concept test E2 for review
backlog.fix: Review the two creative storyboards with the designer, then prepare the approved asset requirements and audience split for owner review.
backlog.reasoning: Higher frequency and lower link CTR justify creative investigation; they do not prove fatigue.
backlog.acceptance: E2 concept, randomization and measurement plan reviewed. No assets uploaded, ad launched or budget changed.

backlog.title: Prepare subject-line test E3 for review
backlog.fix: Verify the engaged audience and suppression rules, review both subject lines and keep the shared message body fixed. Confirm consent and sender/footer details.
backlog.reasoning: Segment mix changed, so the proposal randomizes within one segment and measures clicks instead of relying on opens.
backlog.acceptance: E3 copy, sample feasibility and recipient eligibility reviewed. No email/SMS sent or automation edited.

backlog.title: QA the draft weekly account review
backlog.fix: Recompute every ratio from source counts, inspect row references and keep separate platform attribution cards. Check unsupported claims, creative length and scope exclusions.
backlog.reasoning: A checked review must distinguish observed changes, hypotheses, proposals and missing approvals.
backlog.acceptance: All packet checks pass or carry an explicit expert-review note; exactly three proposals and no blended revenue claim.

backlog.title: Confirm how the review would reach the client
backlog.fix: Confirm the selected client’s reporting destination and permissions with the owner. Review the in-AURA Client Hub-style draft before any separately authorized delivery.
backlog.reasoning: SmartSites’ public Client Hub description does not verify the selected account’s actual reporting setup.
backlog.acceptance: Destination and owner are recorded. This workflow sends no messages and creates no external report or task.
